source_equivalence: Final material assignment changes no articulation geometry. Orientation repair keeps source vertices and UV-to-vertex assignments; the 58 samples were rerun against that repaired geometry.
method: Cross-carrier BVH candidates refined by segment/triangle intersections on fixed-split control quads; explicit contact points, rather than large face centroids, classify engagement zones. This check detects crossing surfaces; coplanar touching and complete containment need separate assembly review. over symmetric and one-sided targets; shared bearing/clevis engagement volumes explicitly excluded; fixed-carrier intersections do not imply moving interference. Not a continuous collision or engineering certification.

rider_and_levers.proxy_basis: Same retained 1.770 m proportional reference, common pelvis Y=-0.10/Z=2.10, 15 degree torso lean, 10 degree knee flare, stated limb radii; comparison aid rather than final rider fit.
rider_and_levers.limits: Radius-subtracted nearest-surface measures are local approaches, not signed penetration or dressed rider certification. Rig/clothing/wrist/seat compression and animation remain later checks.
